verdict.rationale: Finix documents platform monetization tools: a monetizing-payments guide, configurable fee schemas, and fee customizations by payment method, international charges and volume discounts. Together these support setting the sell rate sellers see, and automated reports include fees. Its pricing model is described as a monthly software fee rather than a percentage of transactions, which hints at the provider-side cost structure but is not a documented buy rate. Missing for 10: a documented buy rate or interchange-plus cost schedule, explicit interchange-level cost visibility for managing the spread, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the fee-setting tools.
